decision.reasoning: Both BTC and ETH exhibit strong bullish trend structure across EMA ribbons (EMA9 > EMA21 > EMA50) and elevated ADX. Entering long at resistance without a volume-backed breakout or pullback towards support offers poor risk-to-reward.
